nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a complex number and let $\log$ denote the principal branch of the complex logarithm. A sequence $(\beta_k)_{k \ge 0}$ of complex numbers is the sequence of Apostol–Bernoulli numbers $\beta_k(\alpha)$ when $\alpha \ne 0$, $\alpha \ne 1$, and for every complex number $t$ with $|t| < |\log \alpha|$ the series $\sum_{k \ge 0} \beta_k t^k / k!$ converges unconditionally to $t / (\alpha e^t - 1)$.
nodes.title: Apostol–Bernoulli numbers

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a field of characteristic zero. A sequence of polynomials $(p_n)_{n \ge 0}$ over $R$ is an Appell sequence when, for every $n$, the polynomial $p_n$ has degree exactly $n$ (in particular $p_n \ne 0$) and the formal derivative of $p_{n+1}$ equals $(n + 1)\, p_n$.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
